rv.q: It has an interesting story at its heart with the potential to shock and move, but it's bogged down with excess dialogue and can't punch through.
I could appreciate the intensity of what was unfolding without always feeling emotionally connected to it.

cn.t: Mixed reception for this Almeida revival: stunning lighting and live trumpet create atmosphere, but the production feels slow and the story unconvincing. Style impresses more than substance.
